**Batch 34 authoring is complete.** The A page contains the Clifford quotient definition, its universal property, and the PBW basis with the exterior associated graded. The B page contains one-dimensional and zero-form examples, plus a counterexample to general semisimplicity.

The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-algebra-and-representation-theory/clifford-universal-algebras-and-pbw.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-algebra-and-representation-theory/clifford-universal-algebras-and-pbw-examples.md), [batch manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-34.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-34.proof-contracts.json), [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-34.coverage.json), and [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-34.notes.md) are updated.
